title: AMINE — Active Module Identification through Network Embedding
description: AMINE identifies active modules in biological interaction networks by combining network embedding (node2vec) with a greedy module search and a statistical background correction. This repository is the unified, modernized version of the software, including a command-line interface and a web application.
